Hi Marta —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the W-9 and bank letter. A couple quick clarifying items so we can move this through AP without delay: 

1) Confirm the effective date for the banking change — can OpalWave confirm that invoices dated 2026-05-01 and after should be paid to the new account, and that any invoices dated before that should use the legacy details?
2) For ACH verification we prefer a voided check or a bank letter that explicitly states account and routing (the PDF you sent looks promising; AP will need the bank officer name and stamp).
3) Legal / 1099 name: please confirm the exact company name to use on tax forms (fields must match the vendor legal entity in our system).

Jonas and Rishi, can you start a FIN JIRA for the vendor record update and note PO-9941 as at-risk until verification completes?

If you can reply with the effective date and confirm the bank letter signer, we’ll queue the change.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
